mappings.visualRationale: A tattered, necrotic purple draconic wing with exposed bone joints and decayed webbing set against a deep violet void, perfectly capturing a Lich taking unnatural magical flight.
A radiant golden boot adorned with soaring wings and streaming speed motes, brilliantly representing an Archmage's luminous transmutation spell granting swift aerial levitation and flight.

A scattered pile of gleaming gold, silver, and copper coins with rough minted engravings against a dark surface, directly depicting objects magically transformed into temporary gold and silver currency.
An ancient stone ring archway opening a glowing cyan planar gateway to another dimension amidst a grassy landscape, vividly capturing Rathgamnon opening an interdimensional planar gate.
An outstretched hand channeling restorative vital energy into a floating golden heart amidst radiant emerald rays, perfectly depicting an acolyte's life-giving healing touch.

An erupting circle of sharp jagged ice spikes blasting outwards with flying frost shards and falling snowflakes against radiant blue burst rays, embodying the explosive freezing burst of an Oni's Hellfrost.
